images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one premium editorial illustration for EvoX news about VirtualES: many candidate neural-network parameters can be reconstructed from one shared center and small random seeds, instead of storing full copies. Wide 16:9 landscape. A precise sculptural still life in warm ivory, charcoal graphite and a restrained vermilion red. Central-left a single dense graphite rectangular slab with finely engraved irregular contours, nearby a neat arc of small red seed-like beads; across center-right several translucent thin glass planes carry subtly differing versions of the same contours, as if emerging on demand. Make the material contrast and repeated but varying contour motif beautifully legible, quiet museum-quality product photography, grazing soft sunlight, long controlled shadows, tactile matte stone platform, extraordinary surface detail. Strong single composition, no connecting flowchart arrows. Use ample breathing room, main objects within central 80 percent for mobile crops. No words, letters, numbers, logos, circuitry, robot, neural-network node cliché, or charts. Conceptual visual, not a performance measurement or literal scientific simulation. Opaque warm ivory background.
images.kind: Conceptual editorial art; not measured results or product screenshots.

images.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one high-end editorial cover illustration for EvoX Compiler, about turning numerical programs into inspectable, transformable graphs before execution. Wide landscape 16:9. Architectural exploded-view sculpture: three suspended translucent warm-white square plates arranged diagonally in depth above a charcoal stone base, each carrying an abstract carefully routed graph etched in graphite; discrete vermilion red junctions and one red solid precision-cut element passing through the stages. The first plate has branching paths, the second has clean aligned repeated paths, the final plate is a beautifully compact machined geometric object. Visually convey structural transformation and explicit intermediate stages, not a conveyor-belt factory or a literal UI. Premium Swiss design editorial, warm ivory seamless studio background, graphite and red palette, dimensional materials, precise soft shadows, realistic optical depth, striking composition at thumbnail scale. No textual labels, numbers, logos, source code, chips, robots, neon glow or arrows. Keep meaningful elements in central 80 percent; image must stand alone without typography.
